page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Decorative woodcut border at the top. Below it a dedication in italic heading, then a list of names in capitals with roman and italic text. A signature block at the lower right. A library stamp at the lower left (not transcribed). Faint show-through from the reverse page in the background.

main_text.head: Plurimùm Reverendis, Clarissimis, Excellentissimisque Viris,
main_text.p: DN. JOH. HENRICO ZELLERO, SS. Theologiæ Professori primario, Scholarchæ p.t. Magnifico.

DN. JOH. CASPARO SVICERO, Linguarum principum Professori, & scriptorum juris communis faciendorum Censori accuratissimo, Scholæ item Abbatissanæ Intendenti, ac ædilitatis ad Collegium Carolinum spectantis Administratori fidelissimo.
DN. JOH. HENRICO LAVATERO, Utr. Med. Doctori Experientissimo, Archiatro dexterrimo, Physices ac Matheseos Professori acutissimo.
DN. JOH. HENRICO HEIDEGGERO, SS. Theologiæ Doctori & ejusdem Professori eruditissimo, Scholæ Carolinæ Intendenti dignissimo.
DN. JOHANNI LAVATERO, Logicæ ac Meraphysicæ Professori solidissimo.
DN. JOHANNI MYLLERO, Templi Carolini Archidiacono zelo divinæ gloriæ flagrantissimo, Historiæ Ecclesiasticæ antehac Professori nunquam sine veneratione memorando.
DN. JOH. RODOLPHO HOFFMEISTERO, SS. Literarum scrutatori indefesso, & earundem Professori solertissimo.
DN. JOH. HENRICO OTTIO, Eloquentiæ & Historiæ Ecclesiasticæ Professori meritissimo.

p.i: DD. Præceptoribus, Patronis, Fautoribus, Cognatis, levidense hoc studiorum suorum libamentum in debiti obsequii ac observantiæ πεχμήριον, degustandum summisse ac devotè defert

page.notes: Woodcut border at top is decorative. Library stamp "STADT-BIBLIOTHEK ZUERICH" at lower left omitted. Show-through text from the reverse page omitted. Bold/italic and Greek word "πεχμήριον" as printed (likely "τεκμήριον" in print; kept as shown). Several capitalised abbreviations (DN., SS.) rendered as printed.
